sources.title: YOLOv8s-pose | Radxa Docs
sources.snippet: YOLOv8s-pose YOLOv8-pose is an advanced deep learning model specialized for human pose estimation, launched by Ultralytics. It inherits the excellent architecture of the YOLOv8 series in object detection and integrates object detection with keypoint localization in a single-stage inference process, enabling efficient capture of complex human movements.
